about_the_game:
Carve Your Own Path In a  Forgotten World

Survive a catastrophic crash on a mysterious planet in Chaos Rider, an epic MetroidVania style game! As a powerful robotic adventurer, you’ll unravel the secrets of an ancient civilization buried in a sprawling, non-linear world. Every corner hides mysteries, dangers, and the promise of a legendary treasure—will you find it?

Overcome challenges and discover tools to improve exploration

Master a gauntlet of deadly obstacles as you uncover tools to conquer the unknown! From glowing caverns to crumbling spires, wield upgrades like a grappling hook, a bouncing ball, or a gravity gun and many others to navigate deeper into uncharted territory.

Unleash Devastating Force in Action-Packed Combat

Dominate hordes of dangerous creatures and towering bosses in fast-paced battles! Slash, stomp, shoot and punch with a combat system boasting 6 damage types and a vast arsenal of weapons. Dodge through danger with holographic finesse and crush enemies — every fight is a test of skill and strategy.

Experiment With Mods And Create Your Own Playstyle

Customize your robotic body with mods, weapon-mods, and armors to create a playstyle that’s uniquely yours. Experiment with powerful combinations to unleash chaos, and hatch creatures via the life printer to fight by your side.

Discover a Forgotten Legacy

Encounter strange beings—some allies, others threats—as you explore a world brimming with secrets. Uncover the truth of a lost civilization, face its ancient guardians, and rise as the ultimate Chaos Rider in this unforgettable adventure.

Features

  • A  massive non-linear world full of mysteries to explore and discover. Find your own path toward the legendary treasure.

  • Super cool and fluid player movement mechanics. Use your upgrades and your tools to navigate through the challenges and obstacles at full speed and reach new heights... or new depths.

  • Customize yourself to create your own playstyle with mods, weapons, armors and weapon-mods

  • Hatch creatures that will help you in combat with the life printer.

  • Dodge through foes and hazards with the holographic dodge and stomp enemies head.

  • Fast paced combat system with 6 different types of damage , a large variety of weapons and tons of mods and weapon-mods to customize yourself.

  • Encounter strange characters and creatures. 

  • Uncover the secrets of a forgotten ancient and powerful civilization

short_description: Crash on a mysterious planet in Chaos Rider, an epic Metroidvania! Carve your own path in a vast world full of secrets and battle monstrous foes as an agile and customizable robotic legend. Create your playstyle and find powerful technologies to help you conquer challenges and epic bosses.
